name: Can I patch small drywall holes myself, or should I hire a professional contractor?

mainEntity.name: Can I patch small drywall holes myself, or should I hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY patch kits work adequately for tiny pinholes or shallow scuffs, but hiring a finish contractor is better for holes over two inches, textured surfaces, or visible living areas. Patching involves a practical tradeoff between tool investment and visual quality: DIY repairs often leave visible outlines, uneven sanding marks, or mismatched textures that stand out in direct lighting. A professional drywall and paint team has the right compound, trowels, and spray rigs to feather the edges seamlessly and blend the repair directly into the surrounding wall finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY kits work for tiny holes, but hiring a contractor delivers seamless blending, accurate texture matching, and integrated painting without visible seams or flashing.
